name: Neon Rush 3D Endless Speed Challenge
storyline: Take control of a high-speed jet and speed through a vibrant, synthwave-infused cyberpunk track! Neon Rush 3D: Endless Speed Challenge tests your lightning-fast reflexes as you steer your jet along a never-ending grid filled with deadly obstacles. Shift lanes, pull off daring near-misses, and survive the ultimate neon-lit speed trial on the ground. How far can you ride the rush before a crash?
summary: Neon Rush 3D Endless Speed Challenge is a fast-paced, high-speed 3D endless runner game. Players navigate through vibrant neon-lit tracks, dodging obstacles and testing their reflexes at intense speeds. The game focuses on high-score challenges and quick, responsive mobile gameplay.
